parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses a specific issue with proxy models and select_related/only methods, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch modifies the behavior of query construction, which could potentially break existing queries that rely on the current implementation.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the change does not introduce regressions or new issues.
The patch could be more readable with additional comments explaining the change and why it is necessary.
